title: Koojo Powder Coating: A Website That Shows the Finish Before the Job
storyLead: How Teknoppy designed a fast, photo-led website for a powder coating company, so builders, fabricators and homeowners can see the quality, pick a finish and request a quote in one tap.

atAGlance: Teknoppy designed and built koojopowdercoating.com, the website of Koojo Powder Coating, a powder coating company
The site presents its coating services with real project photos, a colour and finish gallery, the materials it coats and the industries it serves
WhatsApp, call and "Get a Quote" stay on every screen
It is a fast, mobile-first build hosted on Vercel
aboutParagraphs: Powder coating is a visual business. Customers want to see the finish, the colour and the quality before they send a single gate, window frame or batch of parts. Koojo Powder Coating needed a website that shows that quality at a glance and makes it easy to ask for a price.

Koojo Powder Coating gives metal products a tough, even and long-lasting finish. Powder coating resists scratches, rust and fading far better than ordinary paint, which is why fabricators, builders and furniture makers rely on it for gates, grills, railings, aluminium profiles and machine parts.

Like most coating businesses, Koojo has built its name through word of mouth and repeat customers. The website had to turn that reputation into enquiries from new customers who have never seen its work.
challengeLead: Three problems shaped the design brief.

challenges.title: Quality is hard to explain in words
challenges.description: Every coating company says "high quality". Customers believe what they can see: smooth finishes, sharp colours and clean edges on real jobs.

challenges.title: Buyers need quick answers on colour, material and price
challenges.description: A fabricator wants to know if Koojo coats aluminium or MS, which colours are available, how long it takes and roughly what it costs. If the site does not answer fast, they call someone else.

challenges.title: Most visitors are on mobile
challenges.description: Contractors and site supervisors look up suppliers on their phones, often on the move. The site had to load fast and put the call and WhatsApp buttons within thumb reach.

objectiveLead: Build a fast, mobile-first, photo-led website that proves Koojo's finish quality, answers the common questions about materials, colours and turnaround, and turns visitors into WhatsApp messages, calls and quote requests.
objectives: Prove Koojo's finish quality with real photos
Answer common questions about materials, colours and turnaround
Turn visitors into WhatsApp messages, calls and quote requests
approachLead: Five design pillars, and a page order that answers each customer question in turn.

approachPillars.title: A photo-first layout
paragraphs: The homepage leads with large photos of finished work. A project gallery groups jobs by type, such as gates and grills, aluminium profiles, furniture and industrial parts, so visitors find work like theirs.

approachPillars.title: Colours and finishes made simple
paragraphs: A finish section shows the main options, such as matt, gloss, textured, metallic and wood finish, with real samples. Visitors can name a colour or finish when they ask for a quote, which saves back-and-forth.

approachPillars.title: Clear service and material pages
paragraphs: Each service has its own short page that explains what is coated, the process from cleaning and pre-treatment to curing, and typical uses. This answers buyer questions and gives Google clear pages to rank.

approachPillars.title: Enquiries in one tap
paragraphs: WhatsApp and call buttons stay visible on every page, and "Get a Quote" opens a short form. Customers can share photos of the items, the quantity and the colour they need.

approachPillars.title: Speed and trust
paragraphs: The site is a light, modern build hosted on Vercel, so pages load quickly on mobile data. The address, map, working hours and customer reviews sit near the footer to show Koojo is real and local.

approachPillars.title: How the website guides a customer
paragraphs: Hero with photo and quote button: Is this a powder coating company near me?
Services and materials: Do they coat what I need?
Finish and colour section: Can I get the colour and look I want?
Project gallery: Is their work good enough?
Process steps: How is it done, and how long does it take?
Reviews and FAQ: Can I trust them, and what will it cost?
Contact, map and WhatsApp: How do I send my job now?

approachPillars.title: What makes a powder coating website convert
paragraphs: Real photos beat stock images. Customers can tell the difference and trust real work more.
Finish names help quoting. When visitors can say "matt black" or "wood finish", quotes are faster.
Contact must be one tap away. Site supervisors will not search a page for a phone number.
Process builds confidence. Showing cleaning, pre-treatment and curing proves the finish will last.

deliverables.title: Project gallery by job type
deliverables.description: Customers see work like their own.

deliverables.title: Quote form with photo upload
deliverables.description: All job details in one message.

whyMattersHeading: Why design matters for powder coating businesses
whyMattersParagraphs: In metal finishing, the website is the showroom. A customer who cannot see good work, or cannot reach the owner quickly, simply moves on to the next name on Google.
With real photos, clear finishes and one-tap contact, Koojo's site now does the selling before the first call.

Next for the website: add before-and-after photos for popular jobs such as gates and window frames, add a simple colour chart with the most requested RAL shades, publish short job stories with photos for each industry served, and track WhatsApp clicks, calls and form submissions in GA4 every month. Each of these makes the site more useful for customers and gives Google more fresh, original content to rank.

faqs.question: What should a powder coating company website include?
faqs.answer: Photos of finished work, services and materials coated, colour and finish options, the process, reviews, a map, and quick WhatsApp, call and quote buttons.

faqs.question: Why is a photo gallery important for a coating business?
faqs.answer: Customers judge finish quality with their eyes. A gallery of real jobs builds trust faster than any written claim.

faqs.question: Can customers send photos of their items through the website?
faqs.answer: Yes. The quote form and WhatsApp button let customers share photos, sizes and quantities so the team can price the job quickly.

faqs.question: Is a fast website important for a local business?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most local customers search on mobile. A fast site keeps them on the page and helps Google rankings.

faqs.question: How long does a small business website take?
faqs.answer: It depends on pages and content. Teknoppy gives a written timeline and fixed quote after a free consultation.

faqs.question: Does Teknoppy design websites for manufacturing businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes. Teknoppy is a web design and SEO company in Kochi, Kerala, building websites for manufacturers and service businesses in India, the UAE, Qatar and the GCC.
